relationships.evidence: ADEME documents ecoinvent background processes and licence conditions.
relationships.constraints: ecoinvent rights constrain full LCI use.
relationships.validation_question: Track background database version per AGRIBALYSE release.

relationships.evidence: FOODTURE reports integration of leading datasets including AGRIBALYSE in its emerging food LCI framework.
relationships.constraints: Source licences, release versions and transformations must be retained.
relationships.validation_question: Publish record-level lineage and change logs.

relationships.evidence: The project publishes a method for adapting national food LCA databases and cites AGRIBALYSE as a methodological foundation.
relationships.validation_question: Retain source-country data and explicit extrapolation parameters.
